# Design spec

The design spec: one source for the look of every screen. Copy this directory to a new project to reuse it.

## Principles

1. The page never scrolls. The app fills the window. A panel may scroll inside itself. Why: A scrolling page hides the pipeline and breaks on a phone.
2. Below the compact width, show one pane at a time. Keep the pane switch in a dock at the bottom. Why: The thumb reaches the bottom edge. The three panes do not fit side by side.
3. Make every tap target at least the touch size on a narrow window. Why: Small targets cause missed taps with gloves and on a bench.
4. Use one accent colour. It marks the bridge, the active step and the one primary action. Why: One accent tells the reader where to look.
5. Set labels in the mono face, 10 to 11 px, uppercase, with 0.1 to 0.16 em tracking. Set body text in the sans face at 13 px. Why: Mono labels read as instrument markings. Sans text stays easy to read.
6. Build the page as drafting paper: cream sheet, fine grid and ink lines. Make cards lighter than the sheet. Why: The look says engineering, not marketing.
7. Use motion to explain a change: a line arrives, a step finishes. Use the motion tokens. Stop motion when the user asks for reduced motion. Why: Motion that explains is useful. Other motion distracts.
8. Show a state with a word or an icon as well as a colour. Why: Some readers cannot tell the colours apart.
9. Write no raw colour, radius, shadow or timing in a stylesheet. Use a token. Why: One source means one change. A test enforces this.
10. Run the fit check after every layout change. It opens every window size in the viewports file. Why: A layout that fits one size often fails another.

## Tokens

### color

| Token | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--paper` | `#f3eee3` | The page: cream drafting paper. |
| `--panel` | `#fbf9f4` | Card surface, a little lighter than the page. |
| `--raised` | `#ffffff` | A surface that sits on a card: hovered row, terminal, code box. |
| `--ink` | `#1c1b19` | Text, fine lines and dark cards. |
| `--ink-2` | `#5d5a53` | Secondary text and labels. |
| `--ink-3` | `#9a968c` | Tertiary text, line numbers and disabled items. |
| `--line` | `rgba(28, 27, 25, 0.14)` | Hairline borders and dividers. |
| `--grid` | `rgba(28, 27, 25, 0.05)` | Major grid line on the page. |
| `--grid-fine` | `rgba(28, 27, 25, 0.025)` | Minor grid line on the page. |
| `--accent` | `#e8590c` | The one accent: the bridge, the active step and the primary action. |
| `--accent-soft` | `#fde4d3` | Accent tint for focus rings, highlights and the result card. |
| `--on-accent` | `#ffffff` | Text on the accent colour. |
| `--on-ink` | `#ffffff` | Text on a dark card. |
| `--on-ink-2` | `#c9c5bb` | Labels on a dark card. |
| `--on-ink-3` | `#9d998f` | Captions on a dark card. |
| `--ok` | `#2f7d4f` | Success text and icons. |
| `--ok-soft` | `#e5f1ea` | Success tint: kept rows, receipts and done steps. |
| `--danger` | `#b3261e` | Error text and icons. |
| `--danger-soft` | `#fbe3e1` | Error tint: rejected receipts and dropped rows. |

### font

| Token | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--font-mono` | `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` | Labels, numbers, code and the wordmark. Package: @fontsource/ibm-plex-mono (weights 400, 500, 600). |
| `--font-sans` | `"Inter Variable", system-ui, sans-serif` | Body text and titles. Package: @fontsource-variable/inter. |

### radius

| Token | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-xs` | `5px` | Small tags and code chips. |
| `--radius-sm` | `8px` | Buttons inside a control, thumbnails and icon boxes. |
| `--radius-md` | `10px` | Cards inside a panel, rows and the run button. |
| `--radius-lg` | `12px` | Panels and the floating control bar. |
| `--radius-pill` | `99px` | Status pills and receipts. |

### shadow

| Token | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-panel` | `0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) inset, 0 8px 24px -16px rgba(28, 27, 25, 0.25)` | Panel: a light top edge and a soft drop. |
| `--shadow-float` | `0 6px 18px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)` | A bar that floats over the drawing. |
| `--shadow-cta` | `0 8px 20px -10px var(--accent)` | The primary button glow. |
| `--ring-accent` | `0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)` | Focus and active ring. |

### motion

| Token | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--motion-fast` | `0.15s` | Hover and colour changes. |
| `--motion-base` | `0.2s` | Border, shadow and zoom changes. |
| `--motion-enter` | `0.3s` | A new element arrives. |
| `--ease-out` | `cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)` | Strong ease-out for every entrance. |
| `--motion-stagger` | `140ms` | Delay between lines that arrive one after another. |
| `--motion-draw` | `0.8s` | A chart line draws itself in. |
| `--motion-hold` | `1.6s` | How long a confirmation, such as Copied, stays on screen. |
| `--motion-spin` | `0.9s` | One turn of a spinner. |
| `--motion-none` | `0.01ms` | Stands in for no motion when the user asks for reduced motion. |

### size

| Token | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--touch` | `44px` | Smallest tap target on a narrow window. |

## Layout

| Name | Value | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `compactBelow` | 700 | Below this width the app shows one pane at a time. |
| `iconsFrom` | 900 | From this width the pipeline steps show their icons. |
| `stampFrom` | 720 | From this stage width the title block is a boxed corner stamp. |
| `wideFrom` | 1100 | From this width the app shows three columns. |
| `shortHeight` | 520 | At or below this height the chrome shrinks, as on a phone on its side. |
| `compactZoom` | 1.8 | Drawing zoom on a compact window, so the drawing is readable. |
